name: co-mmo
description: A browser MMORPG built by its players through wishes to a God.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @co-mmo/server" "npm run dev -w @co-mmo/client"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client
